recommendations.description: Launch a GA PPO Local acute hospital admission management and reimbursement audit that isolates the facilities and service lines driving claim growth, reviews utilization management KPIs and prior-authorization enforcement with auth-to-claim matching, and confirms contract-based reimbursement for the ARCHBOLD MEDICAL CENTER Signs and Symptoms without MCC pocket.
evidence: GA PPO Local acute hospital spend increased about $2.8M.
The increase was driven by about 1,970 more claims.
Signs and Symptoms without MCC had paid per admit up about $23.5K.
ARCHBOLD MEDICAL CENTER was the identified unit-cost inpatient pocket.
peer_benchmarking: Elevance Health (internal) uses product-line methodology for nonparticipating emergency services and may require documentation.

recommendations.description: Reprocess GA PPO Local inpatient claims in Not Mapped DRG and Not Mapped or ACUTE HOSPITAL facility classes through a mapping and contractual adjudication audit, stratify results by provider subset, and defer broader reimbursement or UM changes until the corrected rerun is complete.
evidence: GA PPO Local spend is concentrated in Not Mapped inpatient buckets.
Acute hospital variance includes Not Mapped DRG as a top driver.
Not Mapped facility claims are flagged unmapped_or_unknown_value.
Validation is required before broad policy or contracting action.
peer_benchmarking: No relevant peer inpatient mapping policy identified; only an off-topic Elevance internal obstetrical policy appears.

recommendations.description: Perform a CA PPO Local Medicare GRS inpatient claims audit for Not Mapped, ACUTE HOSPITAL, and Physical Rehab to verify contractual adjudication and reprocessing, isolate provider-level outliers, review the affected service buckets, and enforce authorization denials.
evidence: CA Not Mapped facility spend increased with higher claim volume.
CA ACUTE HOSPITAL Not Mapped spend rose despite fewer claims.
CA ACUTE HOSPITAL paid per admit increased in the comparison window.
CA Physical Rehab showed flat claim volume with higher paid per admit.

recommendations.description: Perform a GA PPO Local site-of-care policy audit across SNF - FREE STANDING, AMBULATORY SURGERY CENTER, Physical Rehab, and CRITICAL ACCESS claims to enforce authorization-denial edits, reconcile authorizations to actual discharge destination, and verify contracted payment methodology at the fastest-growing facilities.
evidence: GA SNF - FREE STANDING claims rose and paid per admit increased.
GA AMBULATORY SURGERY CENTER claims rose materially.
GA Physical Rehab paid per admit increased on new claims.
GA CRITICAL ACCESS added spend on very low volume.

recommendations.description: Audit OH PPO Local Medicare GRS acute hospital inpatient claims in the Not Mapped bucket and the Degenerative Nervous System Disorders without MCC case to correct DRG mapping, verify authorization denial enforcement and authorization-to-actual matching, confirm final-bill adjudication per contract, and complete itemized outlier payment review.
evidence: Not Mapped DRG drove most OH acute hospital increase.
Paid per admit increased in the OH Not Mapped pocket.
Single neurologic DRG case added material volatility.
Validation needed for mapping error and high-cost spike.
peer_benchmarking: No relevant peer inpatient DRG policy identified; Humana item was off-topic.

recommendations.description: Initiate a targeted provider-level reimbursement policy audit for HOSPITAL FOR SPECIAL SURGERY, WVU MEDICINE PRINCETON COMMUNITY HOSPITAL, and the Missouri chemotherapy acute hospital pocket to validate single-case agreements, contracted payment terms, OON status, and site-of-care steerage; remediate any contract concessions, compliance gaps, or claims payment issues identified.
evidence: MO acute hospital pocket contributed about $116K on roughly 51 more claims.
HOSPITAL FOR SPECIAL SURGERY added leakage across NY, CT, and IN.
WVU MEDICINE PRINCETON COMMUNITY HOSPITAL added about $46K in VA on 3 claims.
Pattern next step calls for auditing steerage, single-case pricing, and contracted terms.
peer_benchmarking: Humana has only a general modifier policy, with no code-specific rule for this DRG pattern.
Elevance internally bundles related unplanned same-hospital readmissions within 30 days; OB delivery excluded.

recommendations.description: Implement a focused provider-, diagnosis-, and service-level outlier review policy for John Muir Medical Center Walnut Creek Camp, Archbold Medical Center, and Phoebe Worth Medical Center IP Med/Surg and NF admissions with diagnoses G20C, I69354, G959, R5381, and Z7409 when procedure fields are -3 or Null or Blank.
evidence: John Muir Medical Center Walnut Creek Camp outliers carried procedure -3.
Archbold Medical Center G959 IP Med/Surg case used procedure -3.
Phoebe Worth Medical Center Z7409 NF case had Null or Blank procedure.
CA NF outliers centered on G20C and I69354.
GA IP Med/Surg outliers centered on R5381 and G959.
